The '''first battle of Vorknkx Project Base''' was a battle fought during the [[Zaarin insurrection]] at [[Vorknkx Project Base]].

==Prelude==
After rogue [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Demetrius Zaarin|Zaarin]] [[Attack on the missile boat convoy|escaped]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn's]] attempt to trap and eliminate him using a [[Missile Boat]] [[Convoy/Legends|convoy]] as bait. Zaarin soon learned that the [[Vorknkx Project]] had made a breakthrough on their progress and sent a [[Nebulon-B2 frigate|Modified Frigate]] [[Z-Borus]] to attack the base. Both the circumstances of the failed trap such as the [[Ambush in the Semag system|ambush]] in the [[Semag system/Legends|Semag system]], that prevented the [[Immobilizer 418 Interdictor-class Heavy Cruiser|Interdictor]] [[Whirlwind (Immobilizer 418 cruiser)|''Whirlwind'']] from participating in the crucial moment of Thrawn's trap, and the fact that the [[Vorknkx Project]], whose ultimate goal was to create a [[Cloaking device/Legends|cloaking device]] that could be fitted onto an Imperial [[Starfighter/Legends|Starfighter]], and was known only to [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], Zaarin and the project staff, caused speculation that [[Spy/Legends|Spies]] working for Zaarin are feeding him cruicial information about whatever is happening in the Empire.

Thrawn sent [[Maarek Stele/Legends|Maarek Stele]], his best [[Imperial Ace]] in a Missile Boat, two [[SCT Scout craft|Scout craft]] [[Sentry (scout craft)|''Sentry'']] to lay [[Mine/Legends|Mines]] around the ''[[Vorknkx]]'', a [[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90 corvette]] that was the testbed of the project and some [[Alpha-class Xg-1 Star Wing/Legends|Assault Gunboat]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadrons]] which were to arrive minutes after Stele.

==The battle==
{{Quote|Mu 1, we were told to expect reinforcements, but one fighter?!|Imperial|<ref name="Star Wars: TIE Fighter">[[Star Wars: TIE Fighter (video game)|''Star Wars: TIE Fighter'']]</ref>}}
When Stele arrived at the facility the staff, surprised that it was just one fighter and only hearing about its abilities, ordered Stele to intercept the attacking starfighters, while the two Scout craft began to lay the mines around the corvette. Stele engaged the modified [[TIE/IN interceptor/Legends|TIE Interceptors]] easily eliminating them while making sure that the unshielded [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE Fighters]] did not reach the scout craft to attack them. Meanwhile, modified [[TIE/sa tactical bomber/Legends|TIE Bombers]] launched [[Proton torpedo/Legends|torpedo]] runs on ''[[V1]]'' and ''[[V2]]'' scoring hits but the shields still held. Stele helped the station defenses destroy the bombers. Stele then moved onto the Frigate ''Borus'' and launched his [[Proton rocket/Legends|Heavy rockets]] at the frigate using his [[SubLight Acceleration Motor/Legends|SLAM]] to inspect the frigate before it was destroyed.

The Gunboat squadrons soon arrived to reinforce the defenses but not long afterwards 4 [[TIE/Advanced starfighter|TIE Advanced]] squadrons arrived, some engaged the gunboats while others went for the facility. After taking heavy losses a couple try to escape but were ultimately shot down by Stele.

==Aftermath==
The facility was damaged but remained intact. However, with its security compromised it was only a matter of time before Zaarin would regroup his forces for another attack. Knowing Zaarin's resolve, Thrawn ordered that the research facility to be evacuated.

==Behind the scenes==
This battle appears in the [[1994]] PC game ''Star Wars: TIE Fighter'', in Battle 11 Mission 6. This article assumes completion of all "Primary", "Secondary" and "Bonus" objectives.
